Arema vs Persijap: Live Stream & Watch Online

As the Indonesia Super League season intensifies, a pivotal clash awaits fans on February 2nd, 2026, when Arema hosts Persijap. This encounter promises to be more than just a regular league fixture; with both teams vying for crucial points in their respective campaigns, the stakes are undeniably high. Arema will be looking to capitalize on home advantage to solidify their position, while Persijap aims to upset the odds and climb the table with a strong away performance. This match could prove instrumental in shaping the narratives of their seasons. Kick-off: 02.02.2026, 08:30 UTC / 11:30 MSK
Stadium: Kanjuruhan Stadium (Malang)
Competition: Indonesia - Super League

Match Preview

The upcoming Super League fixture between Arema and Persijap pits two teams with differing recent trajectories against each other. Arema, traditionally a strong contender in the league, has shown flashes of brilliance interspersed with periods of inconsistency this season. Under the guidance of their experienced manager, they've demonstrated a capability to dominate possession and create numerous scoring opportunities, though their finishing has sometimes let them down. Recent results indicate a team searching for a consistent run of form to push themselves higher up the standings. Conversely, Persijap enters this match as something of an underdog but carries the potential for an upset. Their manager has instilled a resilient defensive structure, often relying on quick counter-attacks to trouble opponents. While their goal-scoring record might not be as prolific as some of the league's top teams, their ability to grind out results, particularly on the road, makes them a dangerous opponent. Injury concerns for both sides could play a significant role, with key attacking players for Arema reportedly nursing minor knocks, while Persijap could be without a crucial midfielder due to suspension.

Team Form and Analysis

Arema

Arema's defensive unit has shown signs of vulnerability in recent outings, conceding goals in their last three league matches. However, their attack, spearheaded by their prolific striker, has largely compensated, finding the back of the net consistently. The return of their influential creative midfielder from injury is expected to provide a much-needed boost to their offensive fluidity and control in the middle of the park. Their strategy will likely involve high pressing and wide play to exploit Persijap's flanks.

Persijap

Persijap relies heavily on a disciplined backline and a swift transition game. Their defensive organization has been a cornerstone of their performances this season, making them a tough nut to crack. The absence of their primary holding midfielder due to accumulated yellow cards might force a tactical reshuffle, potentially exposing their midfield to Arema's creativity. Their expected tactics will be to absorb pressure and hit Arema on the break, utilizing the pace of their wingers to launch quick counter-attacks.

Predicted Starting Lineups

Arema (4-3-3):
  • GK: Adelino
  • DF: Rizky, Fachrudin, Bagas, Alfarizie
  • MF: Hanif, Evan Dimas, Adam Alis
  • FW: Dedik, Kushedya, Dendi
Persijap (4-4-2):
  • GK: Hilmansyah
  • DF: Akbar, Dias, Edo, Ardiansyah
  • MF: Hariono, Syahrian, Beckham Putra, Irfan Jaya
  • FW: David da Silva, Riki Kayame

Match Prediction

  • Main Prediction: Arema to Win. Arema's home advantage and superior individual talent, especially in attack, should prove decisive.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Both teams have shown a tendency to either score or concede, suggesting an open game.

The upcoming clash between PSM and Semen Padang promises to be a pivotal moment in their respective seasons. PSM, under the astute guidance of their manager, has cultivated a reputation for disciplined defense and incisive counter-attacks. They have enjoyed a relatively strong run of form in recent weeks, securing vital wins that have propelled them into contention for the continental qualification spots. However, a slight dip in goal-scoring efficiency has been noted, which they will aim to rectify in front of their home support. Semen Padang, on the other hand, finds themselves in a more precarious position. Battling to stave off relegation, their performances have been a mixed bag, showing flashes of potential but struggling for consistency, particularly away from home. Their manager faces the monumental task of instilling confidence and finding a winning formula against a formidable opponent. Injury concerns could play a significant role in this fixture. PSM is reportedly monitoring the fitness of their star midfielder, whose creative spark could be crucial in unlocking Semen Padang's defense. Semen Padang, meanwhile, might be without a key defender, which could leave them vulnerable at the back. Both managers will be meticulously planning their strategies, with the fine margins often deciding these tightly contested Super League encounters. The atmosphere at the stadium is expected to be electric, with passionate fans rallying behind their teams, undoubtedly adding to the drama of the occasion.

Team Form and Analysis

PSM

PSM's defensive unit has been a cornerstone of their recent success, often stifling opposing attacks and providing a solid platform for their offensive players. Their attack, while potent, has occasionally lacked the clinical edge required to convert dominance into goals. The potential absence of their influential midfielder could force tactical adjustments, possibly shifting towards a more direct approach. Key performers include their robust center-back, who commands the backline, and their agile winger, whose pace and dribbling always pose a threat. Returning from a minor knock, their leading striker will be eager to add to his goal tally and reassert his presence in the penalty box, providing the much-needed firepower.

Semen Padang

Semen Padang's tactical approach often involves a compact defensive block, aiming to frustrate opponents and capitalize on counter-attacking opportunities. Their attack, while not prolific, possesses individual talents capable of producing moments of magic. The potential injury to their vital defender will be a significant blow, potentially forcing a reshuffle in their backline, possibly introducing a less experienced player. Their dynamic attacking midfielder, known for his vision and passing range, will be crucial in orchestrating their offensive plays. The team will likely adopt a cautious approach, focusing on denying PSM space and breaking quickly when possession is won, an approach that demands high levels of concentration and discipline.

Kocaelispor vs Fenerbahçe: Live Stream & Watch Online

As the Turkish Super Lig campaign continues to heat up, a compelling fixture awaits football enthusiasts as Kocaelispor prepare to host Fenerbahçe. This clash, set to unfold on Matchday 22, pits a determined Kocaelispor side, fighting tooth and nail for mid-table solidity, against a Fenerbahçe squad that is firmly entrenched in the title race, vying for supremacy at the top of the table. The stakes are undeniably high for both teams, promising a fiercely contested encounter where every pass, tackle, and shot will carry immense weight. Kick-off: 02.02.2026, 17:00 UTC / 20:00 MSK
Stadium: Izmit Stadyumu
Competition: Turkey - Super Lig

Match Preview

Kocaelispor enter this fixture with aspirations of causing a significant upset and improving their standing in the Super Lig. Their recent form has been a mixed bag, showing moments of defensive resilience but also struggling to convert chances into crucial goals. Manager Fırat Gül will be looking for his side to display tactical discipline and exploit any vulnerabilities in Fenerbahçe's formidable lineup. The home advantage at Izmit Stadyumu will be crucial, with the passionate Kocaelispor faithful expected to create an intimidating atmosphere for the visitors. Conversely, Fenerbahçe arrive in İzmit brimming with confidence, having showcased consistent form throughout the Super Lig season. Under the shrewd guidance of manager José Mourinho, they have established themselves as serious title contenders, demonstrating a potent attack and a solid defensive foundation. While their primary focus remains on maintaining their title charge, they will be wary of complacency against a team battling for survival in the top flight. Expect Fenerbahçe to bring their A-game, aiming to secure a vital three points and maintain pressure on their rivals. Injury concerns for Fenerbahçe revolve around a few key players, whose availability will be a game-time decision, potentially forcing Mourinho to adjust his tactical approach.

Team Form and Analysis

Kocaelispor

Kocaelispor's defensive structure has been their strongest asset in recent weeks, often frustrating opponents and keeping scores tight. However, their attacking output has been inconsistent, with a reliance on individual flashes of brilliance rather than consistent team play. Key striker Mehmet Yılmaz will be under pressure to find the back of the net, while the midfield battle will be crucial for controlling the tempo and supplying their forwards. Manager Fırat Gül might opt for a more counter-attacking approach to exploit Fenerbahçe's forward pushes.

Fenerbahçe

Fenerbahçe's attacking prowess has been the envy of the Super Lig, with a wealth of talent capable of unlocking even the most stubborn defenses. The likes of Edin Džeko and Dušan Tadić have consistently delivered goals and assists, while their midfield, marshaled by highly-rated Süleyman Aslan, dictates play with precision. Defensively, they have been largely disciplined, but occasional lapses have proven costly. With a deep squad, José Mourinho has the luxury of rotating players, keeping the team fresh for their multi-front campaign. Expect a fluid attacking setup designed to break down Kocaelispor's compact defense. Updates on the fitness of central defender Luan Peres will be crucial for their back line stability.

events.dataContent:
Mallorca vs Sevilla: Live Stream & Watch Online

As La Liga enters a crucial phase, the spotlight turns to Estadio Mallorca Son Moix where Mallorca will host Sevilla in an eagerly anticipated encounter. Both sides are desperate for points, albeit for different reasons, promising a full-blooded contest under the lights. Mallorca will be looking to solidify their mid-table position and distance themselves from the relegation scrap, while Sevilla, perennial European contenders, aim to climb back into the upper echelons of the league after a somewhat inconsistent start to the season.

Kick-off: 02.02.2026, 20:00 UTC / 23:00 MSK
Stadium: Estadio Mallorca Son Moix
Competition: Spain - La Liga

Match Preview

Mallorca will be buoyed by a strong defensive display in their recent outings, grinding out results against tough opposition. Their home form has been a particular asset, turning Son Moix into a fortress where points are hard-earned. Manager Javier Aguirre has instilled a resilient and organized approach, relying on quick transitions and set-piece opportunities to trouble opponents. The atmospheric backing of their home crowd will undoubtedly play a significant role in motivating the team against a technically superior Sevilla side. The islanders understand the importance of this fixture in their quest for another comfortable season in the top flight.

Sevilla, under their new tactical helm, arrive in Palma seeking consistency. Despite flashes of brilliance, an inability to convert dominance into goals has plagued their campaign. The Andalusian giants possess a squad brimming with talent, but integrating new signings and finding a cohesive attacking rhythm remains a work in progress. Their recent away form has been patchy, making this trip to Mallorca a stern test of their mental fortitude and tactical adaptability. With European qualification firmly in their sights, every point is vital, and a victory here could provide the catalyst for a strong second half of the season.

Team Form and Analysis

Mallorca

Mallorca’s defense has been their bedrock this season, stifling opposition attacks with a disciplined backline and a committed midfield. Key defender Raíllo's return from injury has shored up their rearguard, providing leadership and aerial prowess. Going forward, they often rely on the pace of their wingers and the opportunistic finishing of their primary striker, who has shown moments of individual brilliance. While not the most prolific attacking unit, their efficiency has been commendable. Manager Aguirre faces no new major injury concerns, allowing him to field a familiar and well-drilled starting XI, focusing on tactical solidity and exploiting any Sevilla vulnerabilities on the counter.

Sevilla

Sevilla's strength lies in their midfield creativity and the individual quality of their attacking players. However, they've struggled with consistency in front of goal. The manager will be looking for his star forwards to rediscover their scoring touch. Defensively, they have shown susceptibility to quick breaks, an area Mallorca will undoubtedly target. Their central midfield battle will be crucial, as winning this duel will dictate the tempo of the game. Sevilla will likely attempt to dominate possession, utilizing their technically gifted players to unlock Mallorca's stoic defense. Injury updates are positive, with only a long-term absentee remaining on the sidelines, giving the coach a full roster to choose from.
